_notes: GOLDEN STAND-IN GOALKEEPER GAMEWEEK — cross-engine contract for the
spec §7 stand-in keeper rule (owner-approved 2026-10-29). Every expected
number below was computed BY HAND from FantasyConfig.futsalDefault()
(spec §7) BEFORE either pipeline ran. Replayed by
test/fantasy/golden_standin_test.dart (Dart, the reference) and
functions/src/lib/fantasy/golden_standin_replay.test.ts (TS port).
Never copy actual values in here — if an engine disagrees, it is wrong.
RULE: a DEF/ATT who plays in goal for a game scores, for THAT game only,
his saves / penalty saves / clean sheet / goals conceded at the GK rates
(CS +8, every 2 saves +1, pen save +5, every 2 conceded -1). Goals,
assists, appearance, cards, own goals, pen misses and DPL stay at his
LISTED position. Position, price, squad slot and formation never change.
In goal = >=1 Save/PenSaved in that game (automatic), OR his name keyed
true in his side's team{1,2}keepers marker (only a literal true counts).
Listed GKs are unaffected (the mapper's inGoal flag is position-blind;
scoring ignores it for a GK). BPS is position-agnostic — unchanged.
Rates: GK goal 10 assist 5; DEF goal 6 assist 4 CS 5 conceded -1/2;
ATT goal 4 assist 3 CS 2 conceded 0. BPS: goal 12, assist 9, save 2,
CS 5, pen save 8, yellow -4.
GAME 0 — Owls 1-0 Bears (no marker: the AUTOMATIC path). Owls' listed
GK Gil is absent; DEF Dana makes 3 saves.
Gil  GK  absent:                 0                          BPS 0
Dana DEF IN GOAL saves3 conc0:   1 + CS(GK) 8 + floor(3/2)*1 = 10
(outfield DEF would be 1 + CS 5 = 6)                   BPS 3*2 + 5 = 11
Omar ATT goal1 conc0:            1 + 4 + CS(ATT) 2          = 7   BPS 12+5 = 17
Ola  DEF assist1 conc0:          1 + 4 + CS(DEF) 5          = 10  BPS 9+5 = 14
Bo   GK  saves2 conc1:           1 + floor(2/2)*1           = 2   BPS 2*2 = 4
Bea  DEF yellow1 conc1:          1 - 1                      = 0   BPS -4
Ben  ATT (attendance only) c1:   1                          = 1   BPS 0
Bonus: Omar 17 -> 3, Ola 14 -> 2, Dana 11 -> 1.
inGoal: Dana true (saves), Bo true (saves — a GK, scoring ignores it),
everyone else false.
GAME 1 — Cats 2-4 Dogs. team1keepers = {Cy: true, Cid: true, Cal: false}.
Cid  GK  marked, 0 events, conc4: 1 + floor(4/2)*-1         = -1  BPS 0
Cy   ATT MARKED IN GOAL, 0 saves, conc4: 1 + (GK) floor(4/2)*-1 = -1
(outfield ATT is never docked: would be 1)             BPS 0
Cal  ATT marker FALSE, goal1 assist1 conc4: 1 + 4 + 3       = 8
(if the false entry wrongly counted: 6)                BPS 12+9 = 21
Cass DEF goal1 conc4:            1 + 6 - floor(4/2)*1       = 5   BPS 12
Dex  DEF IN GOAL (2 Save + 1 PenSaved -> saves 3, penSaved 1), goal1
assist1 conc2: 1 + goal(DEF) 6 + assist(DEF) 4 + floor(3/2)*1
+ pen save 5 - floor(2/2)*1 = 16
Dax  ATT goal2 conc2:            1 + 8                      = 9   BPS 24
Dot  DEF goal1 yellow1 conc2:    1 + 6 - 1 - floor(2/2)*1   = 5   BPS 12-4 = 8
Bonus: Dex 35 -> 3, Dax 24 -> 2, Cal 21 -> 1.
inGoal: Cid true (marker), Cy true (marker), Dex true (saves), everyone
else false (Cal's false entry never counts).
WEEK POINTS (base + bonus), played flag:
Gil 0 F (absent), Dana 10+1 = 11 T, Omar 7+3 = 10 T, Ola 10+2 = 12 T,
Bo 2 T, Bea 0 T, Ben 1 T, Cid -1 T, Cy -1 T, Cal 8+1 = 9 T, Cass 5 T,
Dex 16+3 = 19 T, Dax 9+2 = 11 T, Dot 5 T.

Bo GK, Dana DEF, Dex DEF, Cy ATT (captain), Omar ATT; bench Cass DEF,
